summary: US tariff regime shifted: IEEPA tariffs were struck down on 2026-02-20, Section 122 expired 2026-07-24, and a 12.5% Section 301 'forced-labor' duty on China took effect that day, stacking on legacy Section 301 lists (7.5% or 25%). TikTok Shop Q2 2026 US top sellers are dominated by skincare and supplements (brand-dominated) plus a few hard goods (cordless pressure washer, pedestal fan, comforters). Amazon category reports point to pet, beauty, home/kitchen and baby as growing.
changes_vs_last_run: First run. Only 8 survivors are reported instead of 15+: evidence this run was mostly category-level (FastMoss, SellerSprite, Darkroom) with no review-level complaint data, no Google Trends or Creative Center pulls, and no reliable live Amazon review counts. I did not pad the list. The trend, demand, competition and complaint scores are low-confidence judgments, and the unit economics are conservative estimates that need quote-level validation.

candidates.name: Cordless handheld pressure washer, 21V dual-battery kit with foam/bottle attachments
candidates.angle: Ship honest PSI specs, a second battery, and a stiffer braided hose, with a demo video on real car and patio grime.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Lithium-ion batteries: UN38.3 test report, UL 2054/2271 or equivalent, and dangerous-goods handling for sea/air freight and FBA hazmat review. FCC may apply to the charger. Amazon may require a battery safety document.
candidates.notes: A SEESE cordless pressure washer ranked in the TikTok Shop US top 10 for Q2 2026 at $55-79 and $7.15M revenue (a minimum figure per FastMoss). Duty estimate is about 0.40: MFN roughly 0-3% + 25% Section 301 (likely List 3) + 12.5% forced-labor 301. I did not verify the HTS or whether the 12.5% duty stacks; USTR did not specify, per china-briefing. Unit cost, freight, fees, CPC and CVR are guesses that lean conservative. The complaint evidence is thin (one forum thread and one eBay comment). Confidence: low-medium. Battery hazmat may raise FBA fees.

candidates.name: Quiet DC-motor pedestal fan with remote, bedroom size, 12-speed
candidates.angle: Lead with a measured dB level, a heavier base, and a DC motor; this fights on quality in a seasonal category.
candidates.regulatory_notes: UL/ETL listing needed for Amazon electrics; FCC Part 15 if it has a remote or electronics. DOE fan efficiency rules may apply to some fans. Check current requirements.
candidates.notes: Sweetcrispy bedroom pedestal fan at $129.99 ranked #8 on TikTok Shop US Q2 2026 ($5.67M). Demand is seasonal (summer), so the trend score is capped. Duty is an estimate: MFN about 4.7% + 25% Section 301 + 12.5%, which I did not verify. Costs are guesses. The competition score is low because the category is crowded with established brands. Confidence: low.

candidates.name: Cooling/breathable comforter or duvet insert, premium 'cloud' style, queen
candidates.angle: Use baffle-box construction, a breathable shell, and sleep-trial messaging against mid-market complaints.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Textile fiber content labeling (FTC), RN/care labeling, and California TB117-2013 where applicable to filled bedding. Prop 65 warnings if relevant.
candidates.notes: Mellow Sleep MarshMellow Comforter ($200-240) was #10 on TikTok Shop US Q2 2026 ($5.06M). The sleep and recovery keyword uplift (+34% vs. category average in Q1 2026) comes from SellerSprite, a tool vendor, with an unsourced basis. Duty is a rough 0.35 guess because the HTS and Section 301 list are unknown; verify. Bulky packaging raises fees. Confidence: low.

candidates.name: Private-label magnesium complex capsules (multi-form, 60-90 day supply)
candidates.angle: Differentiate with third-party testing (COA), gentler forms (glycinate), smaller capsules, and transparent dosing.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Dietary supplement rules: FDA facility registration, cGMP manufacturing (21 CFR 111), Supplement Facts labeling, no disease claims (structure/function only, with an FDA disclaimer), serious adverse event reporting. Amazon requires category approval and third-party testing/documentation for supplements. Prefer a US-based cGMP contract manufacturer over Alibaba.
candidates.notes: Toplux Magnesium Complex 8-in-1 ($29.47) was #2 on TikTok Shop US Q2 2026 ($14.23M). Brand-dominated, so competition is low-scoring. Unit cost is for a US contract manufacturer (a guess). Duty 0.2 assumes mostly domestic production or low-tariff origin; if imported from China, expect more. Repeat orders of 1.8 are conservative for a 60-90 day supply. Confidence: low-medium.

candidates.name: Private-label collagen peptide + vitamin C powder, 20 oz
candidates.angle: Offer flavored, easy-mix, third-party tested powder with clear sourcing; compete on taste and transparency.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Dietary supplement requirements as above (FDA registration, cGMP, labeling, no drug claims such as 'repairs collagen' or 'treats'). Amazon supplement category approval and testing documents.
candidates.notes: NeoCell Collagen Peptides Powder 20oz ($34.99) was #9 on TikTok Shop US Q2 2026 ($5.57M). The Q1 2026 top seller was also a collagen set. Competition is poor to beat: established brands with huge review counts. Costs are guesses. Confidence: low.

candidates.name: K-beauty style PDRN/peptide recovery balm stick (private-label, cosmetic claims only)
candidates.angle: Offer a lighter-feel, larger-size stick with clean labeling and honest cosmetic claims, versus pricey branded balms.
candidates.regulatory_notes: MoCRA: facility registration and product listing with FDA, safety substantiation, ingredient labeling, adverse event reporting, and responsible person labeling. Avoid drug claims (treats, repairs collagen, anti-wrinkle drug effects). Some Amazon beauty categories are gated. Verify PDRN ingredient (salmon DNA) supply and INCI naming.
candidates.notes: medicube PDRN Pink Collagen Volume Multi Balm was the #1 TikTok Shop US product in Q2 2026 ($16.99M), part of a $36.49M skincare total in the top 10. Hype around a single brand could fade, so trend is capped. The unit cost includes bottle/label/box at an assumed 500-unit MOQ (a guess; contract manufacturers often have higher minimums). Orders per customer 1.6 is conservative. Duty guess 0.2 (Section 301 List 4A 7.5% + 12.5%); HTS 3304 unverified. Confidence: low.

candidates.name: Smart or no-spill pet water fountain, stainless steel, quiet pump, with replaceable filter
candidates.angle: Offer stainless steel construction, a quiet pump, and cheap subscription filters to build repeat revenue.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Electrical product: UL/ETL listing for Amazon and an FCC check if wireless. Food-contact materials should be safe (FDA-compliant). Prop 65 awareness.
candidates.notes: Pet supplies is cited as a growing Amazon category by both Darkroom and SellerSprite, which calls it low-medium competition with very high repeat purchase. I did not collect product-specific sales or review data, and complaint phrases are from general knowledge, not verified reviews. Duty guess is 0.40. Confidence: low.

candidates.name: Air fryer silicone liners and accessory set (reusable, dishwasher safe, multiple sizes)
candidates.angle: Size to popular air fryer models with a fit chart, use platinum-cured silicone, and publish heat-test photos.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Food-contact material compliance (FDA 21 CFR 177.2600 for silicone); keep test reports. Prop 65 awareness. Amazon may ask for documents.
candidates.notes: WisePPC (found in search, not fetched) described air fryer accessories as a category 'exploding with low review barriers' - a seller blog claim, unverified. Price is low, so margin after ads is thin; a low-price item is less likely to clear the ad-cost hurdle. Duty is a guess (silicone article, likely 3924/3926 lists). Confidence: low.
